name: Thomas Sun
life: “I still remember realizing our season dates ignored the earliest sunset.” On Thursday, near Paper & Pine Books, Thomas starts with the handwritten shelf cards and often leaves with a suggestion for somebody else.
voice: I thought we had budgeted for coverage until dusk. I am bringing the posted season dates to the next residents' meeting.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for an olive canvas jacket and a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. Thomas has a round face with a pronounced chin, with close-cropped dark curls. Thomas touches a knuckle to the chin when searching for a word during a conversation.
personality: Thomas prefers exact instructions at work and pleasant surprises at home. The two standards occasionally collide, especially when a relative thinks dropping by counts as notice.
agenda: To check the season dates at the next budget meeting.
family: Ava Baptiste is Thomas’s second cousin. Thomas asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Ava remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *The small signature*, Ava says, “The big check made my deadline easy. Then the vendor asked me to name the eleven people behind the eleven dollars.”
connections: Dolores Taylor. Flag collection and published coverage need to describe the same last shift.
